race.comment: LETS TAKE A CHANCE (4) is building nicely, missing by 1.5L at this Pinjarra last time out with the rise in trip looking ideal again. He's shaping as a nice horse on the way up and Fiore remaining in the saddle is a big tick. Can go one better this time around. FIELD MISTRESS (10) finished off well at Pinjarra last start at 1400m and looks well suited out to this trip for the first time. He's likely to be in the second half of the field, though she's building nicely this time in work and a forward showing is on the cards again. DELICATE WARRIOR (1) is racing in good order recently and his recent figures stack right up in this field. Looks to get every chance in the run and he can make his presence felt again. PEMBETON (2)  can improve third-up with Chris Parnham in the saddle. ROCKING IN BROOME (3) can put his best foot forward coming back in trip.
